coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Airbnb

Dear Hiring Manager,

Rebuilding a forecasting model from the ground up to lift accuracy from 88% to 96% taught me something that transfers far beyond finance: operational improvement starts with understanding exactly how work gets done today, then redesigning the process around the evidence. That instinct maps directly to what Airbnb's Workplace Operations team needs as it looks across a global office footprint to find where effort is duplicated and handoffs break down.

My five years of financial analysis have been, at their core, about building structure in ambiguous environments. I shortened month-end close reporting from nine working days to six by automating journal checks, and I surface performance data for plant managers through Power BI dashboards built on SAP. These are the same skills this role demands: analytical thinking, process redesign, and translating complex operational data into clear, actionable guidance for stakeholders at multiple levels. I also identified an unclaimed supplier rebate worth approximately $120,000 annually, which required building a business case and presenting it to a regional leadership team without direct authority over the outcome.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my background in process improvement and data-driven decision making could contribute to Airbnb's operational modernization work. I am available at your convenience for a conversation.

Sincerely,
Tomas Brandt
